name: boss
description: Expert-squad workflow for coding agents: PM, architect, UI, tech lead, scrum master, developers, QA and DevOps roles, each held to a contract that an independent verifier checks. Run one stage on an existing codebase or the whole pipeline.

interface.longDescription: Boss turns a coding agent into a structured engineering team. Each role writes an artifact to .boss/<feature>/ and is held to a hard-requirement contract, checked by a script and an independent verifier. Run a single stage on an existing codebase, such as /boss:review on the current branch, or the full pipeline from requirements to shipping.
defaultPrompt: Use Boss to review the current branch.
Run Boss QA on this project.
Use Boss to build this feature end to end.
